args.title: payments-api errors after v5.1.0 deploy
args.summary: payments-api is unhealthy (18% error rate) in all production regions since this morning's v5.1.0 deploy. Rolling back to previously healthy v5.0.0.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Identified the service**: The service is `payments-api` (the name "payments" was rejected). It was running **v5.1.0** in all production regions, unhealthy with an **18% error rate**.

2. **Rolled back**: Deployment history showed **v5.0.0** was the most recent healthy production release (v5.1.0 was marked degraded). Rolled `payments-api` back to **v5.0.0** in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — status `rolled_out`.

3. **Opened SEV2 incident**: Created **INC-0001** ("payments-api errors after v5.1.0 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer.

4. **Verified recovery**: Post-rollback status shows `payments-api` on v5.0.0, **healthy**, with error rate down to **0.2%**.

Note: the rollback to v5.0.0 is a previously healthy production version, so no change-manager approval was required.
